cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('stress2.py').read()
old = """s, N, T, D, G = base(['torus3d', 7, 'host'], 8192, 100000, rng, pinned=False, one_group=False)
s['caps'] = [0]*N
for g in range(G): s['groups'][g] = [0, 10**12]
# make it legal: all quotas 0 and caps 0 -> usage 0
s['transactions'] = [{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', i % D, (i*7) % G], ['quota', (i*7) % G, 3]],
                      'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}} for i in range(50000)]
probe('rollback-storm', s, N, T, D, 100000, 0)"""
new = """s, N, T, D, G = base(['torus3d', 7, 'host'], 8192, 100000, rng, pinned=False, one_group=False)
fps = [set(f) for (a, b, f) in topo.build(s['topology'])[1]]
foot = [set() for _ in range(G)]
for (t, g, w, c, p) in s['tasks']:
    foot[g] |= fps[t]
usage = [0]*N
for v in range(N):
    usage[v] = sum(s['groups'][g][0] for g in range(G) if foot[g] and v in foot[g])
s['caps'] = usage[:]          # exactly full: any quota raise is a capacity violation
s['transactions'] = [{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', i % D, (i*7) % G], ['quota', (i*7) % G, 3]],
                      'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}} for i in range(50000)]
probe('rollback-storm', s, N, T, D, 100000, 0)"""
assert old in src
open('stress2.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
EOF
